newsitem.title: USA: PC Quote ends plans to acquire MoneyLine.
newsitem.headline: PC Quote ends plans to acquire MoneyLine.

text.p: PC Quote Inc., citing poor market conditions, said Thursday it terminated its plan to acquire MoneyLine Corp., the provider of real-time fixed-income information on the Internet.

The proposed acquisition, announced last May, was subject to execution of a definitive agreement. It had called for MoneyLine to become a wholly-owned PC Quote subsidiary in exchange for 350,000 shares of PC Quote common stock.
PC Quote rose 19 cents to $5.19 on the American Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
Chicago-based PC Quyote, which provides online stock and market quotes, said it is still pursuing various joint marketing opportunities with MoneyLine, a closely held company.
